result.topic_en: Power-series expansion of the arithmetic-geometric mean M(1+x,1) via recursively determined coefficients, followed by a problem expressing M(1+x,1-x) as a series in powers of x and a substitution method to derive its coefficients independently.
result.transcription:
Hinc prodeunt aequationes
$2h' = 1$
$4h'' + h' = \frac{1}{2}h'$
$8h''' + 4h'' = 0$
$16h^{iv} + 12h''' + h'' = \frac{1}{4}h''$
$32h^{v} + 32h^{iv} + 6h''' = -\frac{1}{4}h''$
$64h^{vi} + 80h^{v} + 24h^{iv} + h''' = \frac{1}{4}h'' + \frac{1}{8}h'''$
$128h^{vii} + 192h^{vi} + 80h^{v} + 8h^{iv} = -\frac{1}{4}h'' - \frac{2}{8}h'''$
$256h^{viii} + 448h^{vii} + 240h^{vi} + 40h^{v} + h^{iv} = \frac{1}{4}h'' + \frac{3}{8}h''' + \frac{1}{16}h^{iv}$
etc. vnde fit
$h' = \frac{1}{2},\ h'' = -\frac{1}{16},\ h''' = \frac{1}{32},\ h^{iv} = -\frac{21}{1024},\ h^{v} = \frac{31}{2048},\ h^{vi} = -\frac{195}{16384},$
$h^{vii} = \quad h^{viii} = -$ etc. Quare
$M(1+x,1) = 1 + \frac{1}{2}x - \frac{1}{16}xx + \frac{1}{32}x^3 - \frac{21}{1024}x^4 + \frac{31}{2048}x^5 - \frac{195}{16384}x^6$ etc.
Ceterum nullo negotio perspicitur, medium inter 1 et numerum vnitate minorem $1-x$, fore $1 - h'x + h''xx - h'''x^3 +$ etc. $= 1 - \frac{1}{2}x$
$- \frac{1}{16}xx - \frac{1}{32}x^3 - \frac{21}{1024}x^4 -$ etc.
Quum hi coëfficientes legem obviam non exhibeant, has series praetergredimur, aliamque viam tentamus, quae successum feliciorem praestabit.
6. PROBLEMA. Exprimere medium ar.g. inter $1+x$ et $1-x$ per seriem secundum potestates ipsius $x$ progredientem.
Sol. Quum habeatur $M(1+x,1-x) = (1-x)M(1+\frac{2x}{1-x},1)$, statim habetur e serie art. praec. substituendo ibi $\frac{2x}{1-x}$ pro $x$
$M(1+\frac{2x}{1-x},1) = 1 + x + \frac{3}{4}xx + \frac{3}{4}x^3 + \frac{43}{64}x^4 + \frac{43}{64}x^5 + \frac{161}{256}[?]x^6 +$ etc.
atque hinc $M(1+x,1-x) = 1 - \frac{1}{4}xx - \frac{5}{64}x^4 - \frac{11}{256}x^6$ etc.
